bio_en: Ghazar Tarkhanian, known as Deli Ghazo, was born in 1891 in Hartonk in the Bulanikh district into a modest patriarchal family; he grew up herding animals and was barely able to sign his name. As a youth he joined the ARF and served as a courier in the Bulanikh-Khnus area. When the volunteer regiments formed in 1914 he joined Andranik's 1st regiment, and after they were disbanded in 1916 he led a group of refugees with his brother Abgar to settle at Gharaghala in Kotayk. He took part in the February 1921 uprising.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: medium. Brother of Abgar Tarkhanian (d. 1964). The archive editor notes he is not the same as Deli Ghazar (Mikayel Badalkeokhian).
